disambiguation: It is a random note discovery and logging tool, not a general vault search engine.
intentEvidence: Obsidian Plugin for opening (and logging) random notes from a folder
problem: Users who have catalogued many notes lack a simple way to discover a random piece of content to read or review.
summary: Vault Digger opens random notes from a specified folder and logs them in a new note, optionally querying Wikipedia for related articles.
